rows.name: Zero-hit confidence has positive upper bound

runs.intervalMethod: Two-sided empirical Bernstein interval for independent bounded photon-history contributions; Bonferroni allocation over all requested channels and soma bands. Includes worst-case discarded-weight tail. Bounds refer to the finite shell transport model, not to biological calibration.
limitations: Scalar fluence in a thin spherical shell; angular membrane absorption is homogenized.
Optical coefficients are hypothetical uniform effective values; somata do not refract or occlude rays.
Opaque specular liner; geometric apertures. No wavelength-dependent dielectric layers.
Finite-domain escape is lost; shell and domain convergence require separate tests.
Confidence intervals quantify Monte Carlo sampling only; deterministic shell and biological errors remain.
